en.answer:
You cannot activate <<22701>>'s effect if <<11257>>'s effect is applying.

Furthermore, if <<22701>>'s effect is activated, and <<11257>>'s effect is then applying by the time it resolves, or if you activate <<22701>>'s effect while the effect of <<7652>> is applying and you have already Summoned once, you will only『Special Summon this card from your hand,』and will not『Xyz Summon using only this card and the targeted monster.』
